findings.description: render() runs outside the try block. If a subscriber's rendering raises (for example body_template.format hits a KeyError/IndexError/ValueError on a stray brace, or a bad address in Message), the exception propagates out of send_campaign. The loop stops, the report with already-sent recipients is lost, and the caller cannot tell who received the email. Re-running the campaign would then resend to those who already got it.
findings.suggestion: Move render() inside error handling, record per-subscriber failures in the report, and continue. Also handle other mailer errors, so that one bad recipient does not abort the batch and discard the report.
findings.title: Render failure aborts the whole campaign mid-send
